gutter_installation.unit_description: per linear foot of gutter (downspouts priced separately)

aluminum_5inch_sectional.notes: Standard 5 inch K-style aluminum, sectional (10ft lengths)

aluminum_5inch_seamless.notes: 5 inch K-style seamless aluminum, custom-formed onsite, most popular

aluminum_6inch_seamless.notes: 6 inch K-style seamless, handles more water volume

aluminum_half_round_seamless.notes: Half-round profile, decorative, less capacity than K-style

copper_5inch.notes: Copper gutters, develops natural patina, premium appearance

vinyl_5inch.notes: PVC vinyl gutters, DIY-friendly but less durable

steel_galvanized_5inch.notes: Galvanized steel, more durable than aluminum, heavier

downspout_copper.notes: Copper downspout to match copper gutters

downspout_extensions.notes: Plastic or metal extension to direct water away from foundation

elbows_and_fittings.notes: Elbows, adapters, and fittings per downspout

hangers_hidden.notes: Hidden hangers every 2-3 feet, strongest mounting

inside_outside_corners.notes: Corner pieces for seamless gutters (mitered or box)

gutter_installer_rate.notes: Specialized trade, often part of roofing crews

aluminum_seamless_installation.notes: Includes measuring, forming, cutting, hanging, sealing joints, installing hangers

copper_gutter_installation.notes: Requires soldering skills, more precise work, heavier material

downspout_installation.notes: Per downspout including mounting straps, elbows, connection to gutter

old_gutter_removal.notes: Remove and dispose of existing gutters and downspouts

fascia_repair.notes: Replace rotted fascia boards before gutter installation

gutter_cleaning.notes: Clean out debris, flush downspouts, basic service

screen_guards_basic.notes: Basic metal or plastic mesh screens, snap-on
screen_guards_basic.effectiveness: Moderate - blocks large debris, small stuff gets through

screen_guards_premium.effectiveness: Good - blocks most debris except pine needles

reverse_curve_guards.notes: Curved surface, water flows over edge into gutter

foam_inserts.notes: Foam that fills gutter, water flows through
foam_inserts.effectiveness: Fair - degrades over time, needs replacement every 2-5 years

brush_guards.notes: Bristle brush that sits in gutter
brush_guards.effectiveness: Fair - easy to install, moderate effectiveness

leaffilter_leafguard.notes: Premium micro-mesh systems (LeafFilter, LeafGuard brands), professional install only

small_home_150ft_aluminum.notes: 150 LF 5in seamless aluminum with 4 downspouts, standard install

large_home_250ft_6inch.notes: 250 LF 6in seamless for large home or heavy rain area

gutter_guards_whole_house_200ft.notes: Add premium gutter guards to existing gutters, 200 LF

red_flags: Charging >$8/LF for standard aluminum seamless labor (should be $3-6/LF)
Pushing 6 inch gutters when 5 inch would be adequate (unless very heavy rain area)
Requiring complete fascia replacement when only minor repairs needed
Charging >$150 per downspout for basic aluminum (should be $50-125)
Bundling gutter guards without giving option to decline (many homeowners don't need them)
Claiming you need premium LeafGuard system when basic guards work fine
Charging separately for 'disposal' when removal includes it
Insisting on copper gutters for 'durability' when aluminum lasts 20-30 years
Adding 'mobilization fee' for standard residential job
Charging per hour instead of per linear foot
Requiring downspout burial/underground drains when simple extensions work
Pushing oversized downspouts (3x4 is standard, rarely need larger)
Claiming all hangers need replacing (often can reuse)
High-pressure sales tactics for LeafFilter/LeafGuard (very expensive, commission-based sales)

common_upsells.gutter_guards: Especially LeafFilter/LeafGuard at $15-25/LF (basic guards work fine)
common_upsells.6inch_gutters: Upselling to 6 inch when 5 inch adequate
common_upsells.downspout_burial: Underground drainage systems when extensions sufficient
common_upsells.premium_colors: Custom colors at higher cost vs. standard white/brown
common_upsells.heat_cables: Heated gutter cables (rarely necessary except extreme climates)

cost_factors.roof_height: Two-story homes 20-30% more labor than single-story
cost_factors.access: Difficult access, steep slopes, landscaping obstacles add 20-40%
cost_factors.fascia_condition: Rotted fascia must be repaired first, adds $4-10/LF
cost_factors.geography: Heavy snow/rain areas may need 6 inch gutters or extra downspouts
cost_factors.regional_labor: Urban areas and high COL regions 20-40% higher labor

sizing_guidelines.5_inch_gutters: Adequate for most homes, roofs up to 1,500 sq ft per downspout
sizing_guidelines.6_inch_gutters: Large homes, steep roofs, heavy rainfall areas (>60 inches/year)
sizing_guidelines.downspout_spacing: Typically every 30-40 feet, more in heavy rain areas
sizing_guidelines.downspout_size: 3x4 inch standard, 4x5 inch for 6 inch gutters
sizing_guidelines.pitch: Gutters should slope 1/4 inch per 10 feet toward downspout

maintenance_advice.cleaning_frequency: Clean 1-2 times per year (spring and fall)
maintenance_advice.inspection: Check for leaks, loose hangers, proper slope annually
maintenance_advice.downspout_check: Ensure downspouts aren't clogged, water flows freely
maintenance_advice.extensions: Keep downspout extensions 4-6 feet from foundation
maintenance_advice.gutter_guards: If many trees, guards can reduce cleaning but not eliminate it
maintenance_advice.winter: Remove ice dams carefully, don't use salt on roof
